hook.claim: Nearly 1 in 3 U.S. adults got under seven hours of sleep a day in 2024.

beats.purpose: Lead with a current sourced prevalence statistic
Explain sleep hygiene in plain language
Offer wake-time consistency as one starting point
Offer an individualized earlier caffeine cutoff
Offer a cool, quiet, dark environment
Ask for one manageable experiment and give help-seeking context
